_source: research-os/AI_LAB_UNIVERSITY.md v1.0 (approved, frozen). This file encodes the approved skill tree. It does not redesign it.
_model: Competencies unlock by demonstration, not by sequence. A student may enter at any node whose prerequisites they can prove.

competencies.name: Foundations
competencies.description: Can get code from a local machine to a reachable URL and read what the platform says when it fails.

competencies.name: Building
competencies.description: Can build a product surface that real users reach.

competencies.name: Integrating
competencies.description: Can call a model or a paid API from production and handle every branch it can return, not only the happy one.

competencies.name: Operating
competencies.description: Can detect that production is broken, diagnose it from evidence, and write up what happened.
competencies.note: The strongest and least-exploited competency - the failure corpus and operational logs live here.

competencies.name: Evidencing
competencies.description: Can produce a claim that survives someone trying to break it, with the dataset attached.
competencies.note: Shares an evidence base with the Research Hub. Units derive from published studies.

competencies.name: Distributing
competencies.description: Can make something findable and measure whether it was found.
